title: Product of an integer multiplicity representation with (0,1) (Simon 2.17–2.22, 3.2(2)): IMRep, null-set transfer and the Fubini action formula
statement: Conventions: ℝ^N = Euclid N and Hᵈ = μHE[d]. 𝒟^d(U) = TestFormOn U d (smooth d-forms with compact support in U) and 𝒟_d(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U d; ∂X = X.boundary; X − Y is pointwise on test forms. |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α is the Euclidean coefficient norm of a covector and ‖·‖ is the operator norm. M_W(X) = X.massOn W and M(X) = X.mass = M_univ(X). An IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) (contract structure IMRep U d) has μ_R = θ·Hᵈ⌞M = R.measure and R.action(γ) = ∫_M θ ξ(γ) dHᵈ for any d-form γ; X is IM if some IMRep represents it. X vanishes off E if X(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω is disjoint from E. For a map Φ and a form ω, Φ^#ω(x) := ω(Φ(x)) ∘ DΦ(x) (Lean (ω (Φ x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ Φ x)). Let P, k ∈ ℕ and R = (M, θ, ξ) an IMRep of degree k in univ ⊆ ℝ^P with μ_R(ℝ^P) ≠ ∞. Write ι(t,x) := (t, x) ∈ ℝ^{P+1} (Lean WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) and ê₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 ∈ ℝ^{P+1}. Then there is an IMRep R' of degree k+1 in univ ⊆ ℝ^{P+1} with three properties. (1) μ_{R'}(ℝ^{P+1}) ≠ ∞. (2) For every Borel S ⊆ ℝ^P with H^k(M ∖ S) = 0: H^{k+1}(R'.carrier ∖ ι([0,1] × S)) = 0. (3) For every continuous (k+1)-form β on ℝ^{P+1} with sup_y ‖β(y)‖ < ∞: R'.action(β) = R.action(x ↦ ∫_0^1 (β(ι(t,x)).curryLeft ê₀) ∘ D_xι(t,x) dt). Here D_xι(t,x) = fderiv ℝ (x' ↦ ι(t,x')) x, which is the isometric embedding J v = ι(0, v). Explicitly, R'.action β = ∫_M θ(x)ξ(x)(∫_0^1 β₁(t,x) dt) dH^k(x) with β₁(t,x)(v_1, …, v_k) = β(ι(t,x))(ê₀, Jv_1, …, Jv_k).
